versions.changelog:
Initial version introducing read-only diagnostics for Alibaba Cloud OSS multipart upload issues.

- Diagnoses stuck, interrupted, or failed multipart uploads; identifies orphaned fragments and part parameter issues.
- Enforces strict read-only mode: no mutating OSS actions, never cleans up fragments, outputs only manual guidance.
- Requires all diagnostics to run via included scripts; disables ad-hoc commands and direct credential handling.
- Only uses verified script and OSS API outputs—never fabricates results or data.
- Clearly defines symptom-based trigger conditions and absolute scope boundaries for usage.
- Incorporates robust error handling and exit codes; degraded conclusions are explicitly reported when needed.
